name: Health
src_typeComment: Drop-in health component: wire OnDamaged/OnHealed/OnDeath in the Inspector, or call TakeDamage/Heal from code.

src_serialized.name: preventDamageAfterDeath
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, TakeDamage calls are ignored once health reaches 0 — prevents OnDeath firing repeatedly.

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<float> OnDamaged = new UnityEvent<float>();         // amount damaged
src_members.name: UnityEvent

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<float> OnHealed = new UnityEvent<float>();          // amount healed
src_members.name: UnityEvent

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<float, float> OnHealthChanged = new UnityEvent<float, float>()
src_members.name: UnityEvent
src_members.comment: Fires on every change (damage, heal, or reset) with (current, max) — wire this straight to a health bar's SetProgress() instead of recomputing the ratio from OnDamaged/OnHealed separately.

src_members.sig: public float CurrentHealth { get { EnsureInitialized(); return currentHealth; } private set => currentHealth = value; }
src_members.name: EnsureInitialized

src_members.sig: public float NormalizedHealth => maxHealth <= 0f ? 0f : CurrentHealth / maxHealth
src_members.name: NormalizedHealth

src_members.sig: public bool IsDead { get; private set; }
src_members.name: IsDead
ResetHealth
src_members.comment: Restores full health and clears the dead flag — use for respawns/checkpoints.
